claim_text: Some turmeric/curcumin supplements, particularly enhanced-bioavailability formulations, have been associated with rare liver injury; jaundice, dark urine, severe fatigue or upper abdominal symptoms require prompt medical assessment.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NCCIH turmeric resources and safety communications describe potential liver injury reports.
limitations: Do not diagnose causality; assess exact formulation and other causes.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
